aspects.says: Track data, PIN blocks and security codes are deleted once the purchase is answered, because a kept block with its track lets a copied purchase pass the PIN check; a card number is kept only encrypted and shown masked.
basis: section:8.1. Track Data, PIN Blocks and Security Codes Are Never Kept, and a Card Number Only Unreadable

aspects.says: DUKPT encrypts every PIN under its own key, which the host's HSM derives from the BDK and the KSN sent in clear, so equal PINs give different blocks and the BDK must stay inside HSMs.
basis: section:8.5. DUKPT Gives Every Purchase Its Own Key, Derived From a Serial Number Sent Beside the PIN

aspects.says: Every key is kept encrypted under the key above it, with the LMK inside the HSM, and two parties confirm they hold the same key by comparing check values, never the bytes under their LMKs.
basis: section:8.4. Every Key Is Encrypted Under the Key Above It, and Known by Its Check Value

aspects.says: A received MAC is compared in constant time, with MessageDigest.isEqual.
basis: section:8.6. A MAC Proves the Bytes Were Not Changed, and Hides None of Them
aspects.reason: timing can't be graded deterministically; mac-padding-two's starter asks for it and grades only the verdict

aspects.says: A MAC over the message detects any changed byte, depends on how the network pads its input, hides nothing, and is verified against all of its bytes.
basis: section:8.6. A MAC Proves the Bytes Were Not Changed, and Hides None of Them

aspects.says: Format 0 fills with F and gives the same block every time; format 3 fills with random A to F, and format 1 fills randomly and leaves the card number out, so the reader must act on the format digit.
basis: section:8.3. Format 0 Gives the Same Block Every Time, So Format 3 Adds Random Fill

aspects.says: A format 0 PIN block is the PIN field XOR 0000 and the 12 card-number digits before the check digit, so it can be read only with the card number it was built for.
basis: section:8.2. A PIN Block Mixes the PIN With the Card Number Before It Is Encrypted
section:8.2.1. Spot the Problem: The PIN Pad That Passed Certification

aspects.says: TLS protects one connection and ends before the application, while the PIN block stays encrypted and the MAC is checked by the receiving application.
basis: section:8.7. TLS Protects One Connection, and the PIN Block and the MAC Protect the Message
